mcq.s: MS-DOS was first released in:
mcq.x: MS-DOS (Microsoft Disk Operating System), derived from 86-DOS by Tim Paterson, was released by Microsoft in August 1981 for IBM-compatible PCs.

mcq.s: MS-DOS is an operating system with which of the following type of user interface?
mcq.x: MS-DOS is a non-graphical operating system with a command-line interface (CLI): the user types text commands.

mcq.s: 'Windows 3', a popular windowing environment, was released by Microsoft in the year:
mcq.x: Microsoft released Windows 3.0, its popular graphical windowing environment, in 1990.

mcq.s: Windows operating system was developed by:
mcq.x: The Windows operating system is developed by Microsoft (not IBM, AT&T or HP).

why: same fact as gc-gene-8090e811 (Windows is made by Microsoft), added above

mcq.s: American Telephone and Telegraph (AT&T) developed an operating system that gives a multi-user environment. It is called:
mcq.x: UNIX, a multi-user and multitasking operating system, was developed at AT&T's Bell Labs in 1969.

mcq.s: Which of the following is an Operating System?
mcq.x: UNIX is an operating system; Java is a programming language, Oracle a database and MS-Office an office suite.

mcq.s: The central part of the UNIX Operating System is:
mcq.x: UNIX has three main parts – kernel, shell and user programs; the kernel is its core, allocating memory and time to programs and handling files and devices.

mcq.s: What is not true about GNU operating system?
o: Its full form is 'GNU's Not Unix'
It was started by Richard Stallman
It is not compatible with Unix
mcq.x: GNU ('GNU's Not Unix'), started by Richard Stallman in 1983, is free/open-source software that is Unix-compatible but contains no Unix code – so 'not compatible with Unix' is untrue.

mcq.s: Which of the following is not an Operating System?
mcq.x: Microsoft Office is an office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), not an operating system; Linux, Windows and Unix are operating systems.

mcq.s: The memory of the computer is measured by:
mcq.x: Computer memory is measured in bits and bytes; a bit (binary digit, 0 or 1) is the smallest unit. Ohms, amperes and volts are electrical units.

mcq.s: Binary numbers are:
mcq.x: The binary number system has only two digits, 0 and 1, which computers use to store and process all data.

mcq.s: In Binary Code 7 is written as:
mcq.x: 7 = 4 + 2 + 1, so in 4-bit binary it is 0111.

why: same fact as gc-gene-0cbe8b1c (binary uses two digits, 0 and 1), added above

mcq.s: The binary addition 1 + 1 will result in:
mcq.x: In binary addition 1 + 1 = 10, i.e. the sum bit is 0 with a carry of 1.

mcq.s: How many bits are there in a kilobyte?
mcq.x: 1 kilobyte = 1024 bytes and 1 byte = 8 bits, so 1 KB = 1024 × 8 = 8192 bits.

mcq.s: The term bit is the short form of:
mcq.x: Bit is short for binary digit – the smallest unit of data, with a value of either 0 or 1.

mcq.s: The length of a word in computers is measured by:
mcq.x: Word length – the number of bits a CPU handles at once (e.g. 32-bit, 64-bit) – is measured in bits.

mcq.s: 1024 kilobytes are equal to:
mcq.x: In the binary system 1024 kilobytes = 1 megabyte (and 1024 MB = 1 GB).

mcq.s: One kilobyte is equal to:
mcq.x: In the binary system 1 kilobyte = 2¹⁰ = 1024 bytes.

mcq.s: Choose the smallest memory size unit:
mcq.x: Order of units: KB < MB < GB < TB (each 1024 times the previous), so KB is the smallest of these.

mcq.s: Arrange the following units of digital information in order, from the smallest to the largest: A. Kilobyte B. Byte C. Megabyte D. Terabyte E. Gigabyte F. Bit
o: B, F, A, D, C, E
F, B, A, C, E, D
F, B, A, D, E, C
B, F, A, C, D, E
mcq.x: From smallest to largest: Bit < Byte < Kilobyte < Megabyte < Gigabyte < Terabyte, i.e. F, B, A, C, E, D.

mcq.s: Which of the following relation is not correct?
mcq.x: 1 GB = 1024 MB (not 1024 KB); 1 byte = 8 bits, 1 KB = 1024 bytes and 1 TB = 1024 GB are correct.

mcq.s: In computer language how many bytes are there in one megabyte?
mcq.x: 1 MB = 1024 KB = 1024 × 1024 bytes = 10,48,576 bytes (about a million bytes).

mcq.s: A million bytes is approximately:
mcq.x: 1 megabyte = 10,48,576 bytes, i.e. approximately a million bytes (a gigabyte is about a billion).

mcq.s: A MAC (Media Access Control) address is ________ bits long.
mcq.x: A MAC (Media Access Control) address is 48 bits (6 bytes, 12 hex digits) long, burnt into the network card and used at the Data Link layer.

why: answer not exact: Unicode is now encoded in 8 to 32 bits (UTF-8/16/32), 16 bits was only the original form

mcq.s: An exclusively private network used by employees of a company in a single location will be classified as:
mcq.x: A Local Area Network (LAN) connects computers in a limited area such as an office, school or building.

mcq.s: Ethernet is an example of:
mcq.x: Ethernet (IEEE 802.3) is the standard technology of wired Local Area Networks (LANs).

mcq.s: In a database, field is:
mcq.x: In a database a field is one category of information (a column); a record is a set of related fields and a table a set of related records.

mcq.s: Which part of Central Processing Unit (CPU) performs calculations and makes decisions?
mcq.x: The Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) of the CPU performs arithmetic and logical operations, i.e. it calculates and makes decisions (comparisons).

why: same fact as gc-gene-d6de6542 (ALU = Arithmetic Logic Unit), added above

mcq.s: In computer terminology, CD stands for:
mcq.x: CD stands for Compact Disc, an optical storage disc (a CD-ROM holds about 700 MB).

mcq.s: Computer hardware, which can store a very large quantity of data, is called:
o: Both magnetic tape and magnetic disk
mcq.x: Both magnetic tape and magnetic disk can store very large quantities of data; tape is sequential and used for backup and archives.

mcq.s: Which of the following is not a hardware?
mcq.x: An assembler is a software program that converts assembly language into machine code; magnetic tape, printer and CRT are hardware.

mcq.s: Which of the following is not a hardware?
mcq.x: The operating system is software; printer, keyboard and mouse are hardware devices.

why: answer not sure: Google Chrome is itself proprietary (only Chromium is open source), so two options fit

mcq.s: Index hole is related to:
mcq.x: A floppy disk has a small index hole used to mark the beginning point of the stored data on each track.

why: deep technical trivia (IRQ assignments), not in the notes or any Group 2 line

mcq.s: A program that controls a computer's basic functions is:
mcq.x: The operating system is the program that controls the computer's basic functions – memory, processes, devices, files and the user interface.

mcq.s: The brain of the computer is known as:
mcq.x: The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is called the brain of the computer – most processing and control takes place there.

why: same fact as gc-gene-05605807 (the CPU is the brain and most important part), added above

mcq.s: Which of the following is function of Control Unit in CPU?
mcq.x: The Control Unit fetches and decodes program instructions and directs the other units; the ALU performs logical operations.
